name: Poland Aerial Maps
tagline: Browse high-quality aerial photos of Poland
description:
This app gives you a simple way to browse high-quality aerial photography covering Poland. Instead of a standard road map, you get a detailed bird's-eye view of the landscape, useful for spotting terrain features, exploring an area before a trip, or just satisfying your curiosity about what a place looks like from above.

It's a focused, no-frills viewer built around one clear job: showing you great aerial imagery.
